card.name: Linking words before outcome or rate terms
card.fires_on: Small linking or verb words (that, be, were, higher, increased, rate) in the middle of a clause that is about to state a result, risk, rate or consequence. Seen in both medical and general explanatory text.

modes.label: Before risk or rate wording
modes.description: A word like higher, increased or rate sits right before a risk, rate or mortality phrase in clinical text.
modes.example: -risk, post-acute coronary syndrome patients treated with aspirin or the combination of aspirin and clopidogrel, was terminated early due to a<< higher>> rate of bleeding with ELIQUIS

modes.label: Linking word in explanations
modes.description: That, be or were in general explanatory prose, leading into a description of an effect or something brought about.
